headline: North Korea considers closing Swiss diplomatic office after sanctions on youth camp
label: NEWS
caption:
North Korea is reviewing its relations with Switzerland and considering shutting down its diplomatic office in Pyongyang.

According to Reuters and Anadolu, the move comes after Switzerland imposed sanctions on a North Korean youth camp linked to the Russia Ukraine war.

North Korea has strongly slammed Switzerland over these measures, KCNA reports.
